title: libds spec-testing strategy
preamble:
# libds spec-testing strategy

The discipline specific to `runtime/tests/libds/spec/` —
how spec tests are scoped, how their `<id>` slot is
filled, and how spec drift is handled when found.

The **structural conventions** (per-scenario functions,
naming with `__` separator, run-all-aggregate `main()`,
fixture isolation, sentinel checks) are SHARED with the
impl suite and live in [ITST.5]. This doc covers only
what's distinct about spec tests.

## What this is not

- Not the test-tree layout. See [ITST.2].
- Not the structural conventions. See [ITST.5].
- Not the impl-test discipline. Author-of-feature also
  writes the impl test; reaching internal headers is
  fine.
- Not the dispatcher contract. Spec tests cite
  [IDSP]; they don't redefine.
